Card Q&A.a: Yes, even if you only reveal one of the applicable cards, you can still add it to your hand.
Card Q&A.q: The cards I reveal with this effect include only a level 5 or level 6 digimon, not both. Can I add that card to my hand?

Effect: [On Play] Reveal the top 3 cards of your deck. Add 1 level 5 and 1 level 6 Digimon card among them to your hand. Trash the remaining cards.
